This product does it! I have been struggling with acne for the past 6 months, and felt like nothing helped. I would find products that were decent, but would leave my skin dry or oily or itchy. This moisturizer helps fight the acne with the salicylic acid, but also moisturizes without leaving my skin oily, tight, or contributes to irritating the acne spots. Great products, I do recommend you wait this product out for a month or so, because that's when you really start seeing the results you are wanting!

avis.titre: Stick with it, SO Worth it
avis.texte: Initially, very underwhelmed w/this product. Decided to finish my small sample tube & wow! In my 50's w/normal-dry skin & VERY acne prone. I never get full blown whiteheads nor blackheads just a few congested / closed comedones (always same spot). In almost 3 weeks, no returning comedones plus comfortable hydration & smoooooth skin. Be patient & of you have that stubborn/mild acne on NOT oily skin, this is for you!

I have been a happy Tula customer for over a year. I recently purchased this moisturizer and when I got towards the end of the bottle, there were hard shards of something mixed in with the lotion. I contacted customer service, and they told me that the product had crystallized and if I was within 60 days to return it. Unfortunately, it was just over 60 days so I had to throw it away. It is way too expensive of a product for this to happen and customer service was not helpful. I would take your money elsewhere!
